title: One provider, two interfaces
body: Compare upstream collection lineage before counting corroboration. Overpass and OSM are one map dataset, not two witnesses.

title: A failed pivot is evidence too
body: Record a dead end and the coverage limit. Do not silently replace the research question until a result appears.

title: Certificates suggest names, not ownership
body: Treat certificate SANs as candidate edges. Check dates, service providers and official ownership evidence before joining entities.

title: Shared infrastructure is a weak edge
body: CDNs, registrars, templates and analytics services create accidental connections. Try a shared-provider explanation first.

title: Search before submitting
body: Read existing urlscan records before considering a new scan. A submission can contact the target and disclose the URL.

title: CenQL is not legacy Censys syntax
body: Use dataset-prefixed fields and current platform documentation. Do not blindly paste a legacy services.port query into CenQL.

title: Pin code evidence to a commit
body: A branch URL can change. Record the repository, commit SHA, path and exact lines supporting the observation.

title: Ecosystem + package + version
body: Resolve the complete package coordinate. A name match across npm and PyPI is not an identity match.

title: Model cards are claims
body: Record the card revision and its references without executing weights. Separate declared lineage from independently evidenced lineage.

title: Use legal identifiers before names
body: Carry registration number, jurisdiction, CIK or LEI through the chain. Names are useful for discovery, not definitive joins.

title: Notice does not mean award
body: Check procurement notice type, amendments and award evidence before describing a supplier relationship.

title: A match is a review queue
body: Compare identifiers, dates and jurisdiction with the original sanctions source. Never treat a fuzzy name score as a verdict.

title: Capture date is not publication date
body: Record both when known. A page may have been published long before its first capture, and replayed assets can have mixed dates.

title: Compare content, not only digests
body: Digest changes can reflect counters or layout. Inspect the exact claim and retain a dated before/after observation.

title: Metadata can be edited
body: Hash before working, inspect a copy and corroborate metadata against visible facts. Missing EXIF is not evidence of fabrication.

title: Use shadows to falsify, not certify
body: Test whether geometry contradicts a candidate place and time. A compatible sun position rarely determines a unique answer.

title: A hotspot does not name its cause
body: Check sensor, time, resolution and competing explanations. Do not label a fire, explosion or responsible party from one detection.

title: Ten headlines can be one witness
body: Trace syndication and copied quotes to the original observation. Count independent evidence chains, not article URLs.

title: An anomaly is not intent
body: Compare control tests, networks and dates before inferring blocking. Sparse or failed measurements need explicit caveats.

title: Preserve the negative claim boundary
body: Write what the evidence does not establish alongside the conclusion. Distinguish observed, inferred and unknown throughout the report.
